name: Frenzy Clusters

features.name: Rock expansions
features.description: Rocks extend the field and reveal multipliers in the bonus.

features.name: Mystery buy
features.description: One of three buy options sends you to a random bonus.

review:
Before you start, you pick one of five heroes, and each sends you on a different adventure. Underneath, it's a cluster-pays game with two unique bonuses.

Wins can break rock symbols that open up the playing field for a spin; in the bonus, cleared rocks reveal three random multipliers and the field keeps growing until the round ends. There's even a Mystery buy that drops you into a random bonus mode. High volatility, 10,000x max and a 97.11% RTP. Free spins about once every 269 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.11% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
